mapper.sql: SELECT c.ca_no AS CA_NO, c.ca_token AS CA_TOKEN, c.ca_quantity AS CA_QUANTITY, c.ca_yn AS CA_YN, c.ca_qty AS CA_QTY, c.ca_at AS CA_AT, c.ca_up AS CA_UP, c.m_no AS M_NO, c.p_no AS P_NO, c.o_no AS O_NO, p.p_title AS P_NAME, o.o_main_img AS P_MAIN_IMG, o.o_price AS O_PRICE, (o.o_type_size || CASE WHEN o.o_color IS NOT NULL THEN ' / ' || o.o_color END) AS O_NAME, o.o_quantity AS O_QUANTITY FROM dc_cart c JOIN dc_product p ON c.p_no = p.p_no LEFT JOIN dc_product_option o ON c.o_no = o.o_no
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dc_cart ( ca_token, ca_quantity, ca_yn, ca_qty, ca_at, ca_up, m_no, p_no, o_no ) VALUES ( #{caToken, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{caQuantity, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{caYn, jdbcType=CHAR}, #{caQty, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE, #{mNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{pNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{oNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC} )
mapper.update: UPDATE dc_cart SET ca_quantity = #{caQuantity}, ca_up = SYSDATE WHERE ca_no = #{caNo}
UPDATE dc_cart SET ca_yn = #{caYn}, ca_qty = #{caQty}, ca_up = SYSDATE WHERE ca_no = #{caNo}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM dc_cart WHERE ca_no IN #{caNo}
mapper.select: WHERE c.m_no = #{mNo} ORDER BY c.ca_at DESC
WHERE c.ca_token = #{caToken} AND c.m_no IS NULL ORDER BY c.ca_at DESC
